integrity: Exact finite integral chain computations and second signed fixed-simplex enumeration provided with reproducible programs.
scientific_limitations: No equivariant homotopy equivalence, integral D4-module splitting, quotient torsion classification, or general-width theorem is asserted. Possible unindexed earlier equivalent calculation remains.
scientific_scope: One ordinary matching complex on the 16-vertex Cartesian 4 by 4 grid, with full rational D4-equivariant reduced homology and rational orbit-space homology.
title: The full \(D_4\)-homology character of the \(4\times4\) grid matching complex
